messages.subject: Highlighting Problem
parts:
Greetings,

I'm thrilled with being able to teach my undergraduate statistics
course using Deducer. There are some small problems that I'm coming
across while my students are learning about the software.

When running Deducer on OS X there is a 'highlighting' problem. By
that I mean within the Data Viewer (a) Moving between options in the
Data Set pull down menu the different options remain highlighted, (b)
During data entry, after hitting the return key and move to a new
cell, the old cell remains highlighted.

Cheers,
Roger
